_about: Schema for data/home-canon.json (gitignored — the family's own characters). The third registry: the roster answers 'which real people exist', the story worlds' casts answer 'which canon characters exist', this answers 'which of OUR characters exist' — the recurring invented characters the family keeps. One canonical spelling each, added ONLY through the Roster page's 'Our characters' section (add-only, validated: collisions with existing characters and with any roster form are refused). Effects: familyfix never questions a correctly-spelled home character; spellingfix proposes the registered spelling for a cluster containing one; world-less spelling clusters file their rulings under the 'Home' world (data/name-book/home.json).
